description: Frontend redesign: rewrite templates/index.html to show only VISTA title, upload, query, answer text, and matched frame; create templates/debug.html with all technical detail. Depends on FEAT-001 (render_home() must already accept the slim 5-field signature).
steps:
Step 1 — Rewrite templates/index.html. Keep the dark theme CSS variables (--bg, --bg-2, --panel, --accent, --accent-2, --danger, --success, --shadow, --line, --text, --muted) and all base body/page/font styles. Remove CSS for .status-card, .kv, .evidence-grid, .results-grid, .results-cards, .image-meta, .footer-links, pre.json — those move to debug.html only. The page layout from top to bottom: (1) header .brand div with eyebrow tag 'Visual Intelligence Search & Tracking Architecture', h1 'VISTA', subtitle 'Upload a video and ask a question in plain language.'; (2) .form-card section with video file input (id=video, name=video, accept=video/*), query textarea (id=query, name=query, placeholder='Find the person near the car.'), Search button (type=submit), error banner ({% if error %} div.error {{ error }} {% endif %}); (3) {% if answer_text %} .answer-card section with a label 'VISTA says:' and

{{ answer_text }}

{% endif %}; (4) {% if matched_image %} .frame-card section with {% endif %}; (5)
Developer debug info →
. The form action is POST /process with enctype=multipart/form-data. Do NOT include: track_id, confidence, bounding boxes, JSON blobs, CSV links, processing stats, runtime/model status, assistant_mode, candidate counts, search scores.
Step 2 — Create templates/debug.html. Copy the full
acceptance_criteria: python -c "from app import app; c = app.test_client(); r = c.get('/'); assert r.status_code == 200; data = r.data.decode(); assert 'VISTA' in data; assert 'track_id' not in data; assert 'confidence' not in data; assert 'debug' in data.lower(); print('main page ok')" exits without error

python -c "from app import app; c = app.test_client(); r = c.get('/debug'); assert r.status_code == 200; data = r.data.decode(); assert 'debug' in data.lower() or 'No results' in data; print('debug page ok')" exits without error
Main page HTML contains no occurrences of the strings: track_id, confidence, bounding box, detections_csv, frames_processed, parse_result, search_result
Debug page HTML contains sections for: Parsed query intent, Processing stats, Evidence, CSV download links
